title: MSCA Doctoral Position
institution: Stockholm School of Economics (SSE), Department of Management and Organization
field: Management and organization (human-AI coexistence in professional service firms)
about: The Stockholm School of Economics' Department of Management and Organization, Sweden, offers a full-time doctoral position in the EMANAIRE MSCA Doctoral Network, studying human-AI coexistence in professional service firms. Applications are open from 1 December 2026 to 15 January 2027, 23:59 CET.
requirements: Declaration concerning doctoral status and compliance with the MSCA mobility rule

upskill.name: Building an AI-Ready Organization
why: Field "Management and organization (human-AI coexistence in professional service firms)" -> objective "Define the roles, competencies, organizational capabilities, and decision structures required to scale AI successfully."

Field "human-AI coexistence in professional service firms" -> objective "Assess organizational readiness across strategy, leadership, people, processes, technology, data, governance, culture, and operating capabilities."
